hook: The sentence each zodiac sign has been waiting for

items.title: Aries
bullets: You don't have to earn the rest. You're allowed to just stop.
It was never too much. You just kept asking people who had less to give.
You can put the armour down here. Nothing is coming.
Being first isn't the same as being wanted, and you deserve to be wanted.
You were never hard to love. You were just never properly held.

items.title: Taurus
bullets: Wanting things to stay is not the same as being afraid of change.
You are allowed to take up the space you've been apologising for.
Your slowness is not indecision. You are making sure it's real.
Someone can love you without you having to make yourself useful first.
You've been the steady one so long that nobody asked who steadies you.

items.title: Gemini
bullets: You are not too much. You're just the only one still saying it out loud.
Being easy to talk to is not the same as being easy to know.
You're allowed to be tired without anyone deciding you've changed.
The people who called you flighty never once asked what you were running from.
You don't owe anyone the lighter version of you today.

items.title: Cancer
bullets: You are allowed to need things out loud. It isn't a burden.
Feeling it that deeply is not a defect. It's the reason people come to you.
You can stop bracing. Not everyone is deciding whether to leave.
You have been someone's home for years. You're allowed to want one back.
Nothing you feel needs to be smaller before it's allowed.

items.title: Leo
bullets: You can be loved on the days you're not impressive.
Needing reassurance doesn't make you weak. It makes you honest.
You've been performing so long you forgot you were allowed to just arrive.
The room lighting up isn't the price of being kept.
Someone is going to choose you quietly, and it will still count.

items.title: Virgo
bullets: It's already good enough. It was three versions ago.
You don't have to be useful to be allowed to stay.
You are allowed to be a person, not a system that never breaks.
Nobody is keeping the list you think they're keeping.
You can be loved at your messiest, and it doesn't undo any of it.

items.title: Libra
bullets: You're allowed to want something specific, even if it disappoints someone.
Keeping the peace is not the same as being at peace.
You have an opinion. It's allowed to be inconvenient.
Being chosen shouldn't require you to become smaller and easier first.
You can say no and still be the kind person you've always been.

items.title: Scorpio
bullets: Not everyone is studying you for a weakness.
You're allowed to be known before someone has fully earned it.
The loyalty you give would be enough for anyone. That was never the problem.
You don't have to test them. You're allowed to just ask.
Being intense is not a warning. It's the whole reason they stayed.

items.title: Sagittarius
bullets: Staying is not the end of your life. It's allowed to be the good part.
You're not restless. You've just never been given a reason to be still.
Someone can hold you without holding you back.
You are allowed to want a home and still want the world.
The people who called you unserious never saw what you protect.

items.title: Capricorn
bullets: You are allowed to rest before you've finished. It's not a failure.
Your worth was never the output. It just got measured that way.
You're allowed to be carried by someone for a while.
Nobody needs you to be the reliable one every single day.
You can stop proving it. They already believe you.

items.title: Aquarius
bullets: Needing people doesn't make you like everyone else.
You're allowed to be close without disappearing into it.
The distance you keep isn't protecting you the way you think it is.
Someone can understand you without you having to explain it perfectly.
You don't have to be the exception. You're allowed to just belong.

items.title: Pisces
bullets: You are not too soft for this world. The world is just harder than you.
You're allowed to want the real thing and not the version you imagined.
Your kindness was never naive. You always knew, and gave it anyway.
You can stop absorbing what isn't yours to carry.
Someone is going to love you carefully, and it won't feel like a fantasy.

caption:
Which one made you stop scrolling? 🫶

Save this for the day you need to hear it again.
